titulo: Esperar que + present perfect subjunctive (completed action in the future)
subtitulo: Espero que hayas terminado para el viernes.
regla: Esperar que + haya + participle can express a hope that something will be done by a future point: Espero que lo hayas decidido antes del lunes. There's usually a future reference (para entonces, antes de..., el lunes).

bloques.texto: The **present perfect subjunctive** after **esperar que** can also look **forward**: you hope something **will have happened** by a certain point.
Look for the time reference: **para entonces, para el viernes, antes de..., el próximo lunes, cuando vuelva**.
English uses _will have done_; Spanish uses **haya hecho**, never the future perfect after **esperar que**.
Tip: same form as the past use; the time phrase tells you it's the future.

lista.es: Espero que ==hayas tomado== una decisión antes de la fecha acordada.
lista.en: I hope you'll have made a decision before the agreed date.

lista.es: Esperamos que ==hayan encontrado== lo que buscan para entonces.
lista.en: We hope you'll have found what you're looking for by then.

lista.es: Ella espera que yo ya ==haya cobrado== el próximo lunes.
lista.en: She hopes I'll have been paid by next Monday.

lista.es: Espero que ==hayan arreglado== la calle cuando regresemos.
lista.en: I hope they'll have fixed the street by the time we get back.

filas.t: Espero que hayas terminado para las cinco.

lista.nota: Same form; the time phrase decides.

filas.t: Espero que habrás terminado para el lunes.
Espero que hayas terminado para el lunes.

lista.texto: The past use: [[6010|esperar que for the past]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I hope you'll have finished by Friday._ (tú)
lista.r: Espero que hayas terminado para el viernes.

lista.p: In Spanish: _We hope they'll have arrived by then._
lista.r: Esperamos que hayan llegado para entonces.

lista.p: Fix it: _Espero que habrán vuelto antes de la cena._
lista.r: Espero que hayan vuelto antes de la cena.
